text:
QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` | `#define`d to your functions at compile time. No runtime indirection, and `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` is compiled out."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer distinguishes the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair and says the setter is compiled out when the macros are used, which conveys mutual exclusivity.
